summary: Test-writing phase for issue #39 complete. Solver parity corpus (upstream viamin/color_matching#112, corpus v1, commit a82aec5) committed byte-identical at ColorComposerCore/Tests/ColorComposerCoreTests/Fixtures/parity/v1/corpus.json and replayed by SolverParityCorpusTests: 6/6 green, 12/12 scenarios exact (selections, errors, four tie shapes, exclusions, zero-weight and unknown-channel weight handling) at 1e-12 tolerance, through both WeightedSquaredErrorScorer and the CompositionSolver fast path. /api/v1 wire contracts pinned green by new PaletteAPIClientContractTests (6/6) and the existing ProfileColorCacheTests cache suite, forming the preservation net for the OpenAPI migration. GeneratedClientAdoptionTests are red by design (3 assertion failures across 2 tests): the generated client is not adopted at this tests-only head, so the criterion is recorded as failed pending the implementation run. Suite total at head: 222 tests, 219 passed, 3 expected red-phase failures. Executed on Linux aarch64 with Swift 6.1.3 (ColorComposerCore only; the macOS app target cannot build off-Apple). One pre-existing compile defect in PaletteAPIClientTests.swift:32 (@Sendable closure implicit self) was fixed so the SwiftPM test target builds at all; no behavior changed. App-side offline-stale badge UI tests (ColorMatchingTests, macOS/Xcode-only) could not be executed in this environment.

acceptance_criteria.description: Add swift-openapi-generator + swift-openapi-runtime to ColorComposerCore; generate typed client; migrate/wrap PaletteAPIClient

verification.notes: Red by design at this tests-only head (implementation deferred to the post-approval run). Both adoption guards executed and failed for the intended reason: manifest lacks the dependencies and no package source imports OpenAPIRuntime. Upstream OpenAPI spec (viamin/color_matching#110) is not yet published, so the generated client is additionally blocked on it. Behavior the migration must preserve is pinned green by AC-2 tests.

references.detail: testPackageManifestDeclaresOpenAPIGeneratorAndRuntime: 'Package.swift must declare swift-openapi-generator' + '...swift-openapi-runtime' — executed, expected red-phase failure
testPackageSourcesLinkTheOpenAPIRuntime: no package source imports OpenAPIRuntime — executed, expected red-phase failure

acceptance_criteria.description: Preserve existing behavior: per-server/profile color caching, offline-stale badges, cached profile fallback

verification.notes: Package-level preservation net executed green at this head (208 pre-existing tests re-run green plus 6 new wire-contract tests). Offline-stale badge UI lives in the macOS app (ColorMatchingTests) and cannot run off-Apple; cache + fallback + the wire shapes that feed the badges are covered in ColorComposerCore. These suites are the regression net the implementation run must keep green.

references.detail: per-server/profile disk cache, namespace isolation, clear/repopulate, corrupt-file misses — executed green (full suite)
6/6 green: /api/v1 paths, printer_profile_id query, envelopes, absent-token header, 401/5xx/malformed mapping, testConnection
missing measurements absent-not-zero, unknown light-source drop — executed green (full suite)
